courses.desc_en: The course introduces fundamental knowledge of modeling activities in transportation, logistics, and supply chain management, along with practical exercises using selected modeling software

courses.desc_en: Application of LP/MLP models for logistics center planning and multimodal transport optimization. Case study of a specific project.
